For every other observed sub-state behaviour (walk/attack; the hit sequence observed inside sub-state 0x02 under action word +0x06; the KO sequence observed in sub-states 0x04/0x06) the value shows corpus-OBSERVED constancy at that class's state-0 value over the four deterministic MAME routes. Do not assume 0x00130AC8: the per-class constants are 0x0012CE5C (class 0x00 type_promotion), 0x0013E97A (class 0x06 replace), 0x00130AC8 (class 0x1F normal).
